title: Truncating a Lovász sample
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let $R$ be a type with a natural-number cast, and let $m$ be a natural number such that $n^2k\le m$. For every Boolean word $l$, the sample constructed from the first $m$ bits of $l$ equals the sample constructed from all of $l$.
